method: Each mutant replaced its old fragment (asserted to occur exactly once) in the tested file at testedCommit, ran `npx vitest run apps/three-surface-poc/src/fresh-checkout-verdict.test.ts --reporter=json` from the repository root, and restored the original bytes; the restored file was asserted byte-identical to testedFileSha256 before this record was written. A mutant is killed when at least one test fails. testedCommit may become unreachable after a rebase-merge; testedFileSha256 is the stable anchor.
